STAT_WHEEL1_SENSOR_SPEED_WERT : Speed measured by the sensor of the wheel 1 and transmitted on the bus
STAT_WHEEL2_SENSOR_SPEED_WERT : Speed measured by the sensor of the wheel 2 and transmitted on the bus
STAT_WHEEL3_SENSOR_SPEED_WERT : Speed measured by the sensor of the wheel 3 and transmitted on the bus
STAT_WHEEL4_SENSOR_SPEED_WERT : Speed measured by the sensor of the wheel 4 and transmitted on the bus
STAT_COMBINED_SENSOR_SPEED_WERT : Combined speed measured by the sensors of the car and transmitted on the bus
STAT_GPS_SPEED_WERT : Speed calculated on the basis of the GPS signals
STAT_SPEED_DIFFERENCE_PERCENT_WERT : Speed difference in percent between the combined sensor speed and the GPS speed
